elen: Received DSAR from EU customer asking for proof that PII for subject_id=9988 was removed from backups & snapshots. Legal requests verifiable evidence. Do we need KMS decrypt or is a signed deletion manifest + redacted audit export sufficient?

noah: Signed manifest + auditable signature chain usually ok. Avoid granting decrypt to humans.

priya: Agreed. Proposed approach: generate deletion manifest with ops-runner job IDs, SHA256 manifest hash, timestamp, and sign with our keystore signing key. Provide redacted log excerpts showing the delete jobs ran and completed.

elen: What minimal RBAC do we need so ops can produce and verify these artifacts without excessive key perms?

noah: Create ephemeral role `privacy-verifier` for a service account with only `keystore.keys.verify` and `logging.read` scoped to the target project and specific log names. TTL 1h. No decrypt or key material export.

priya: We'll also scrub snapshot metadata before any artifact leaves infra. No raw snapshot blobs. Example audit export steps:```bash
curl "https://logs.internal/export?filter=delete_job AND subject:9988&from=2023-06-01&to=2023-09-01" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" > tmp.json
jq 'del(.entries[].payload.user_email,.entries[].payload.account_id)' tmp.json > tmp-redacted.json
```

compliance-bot: retention-policy-check: requested logs are 110 days old, default retention = 90 days. Retention exception required. Please open ticket COM-1452 with justification and TTL.

elen: I'll open COM-1452 and include legal justification + limited TTL (until 2024-06-30). Priya, can you prepare manifest template and sample signed file?

priya: Will do. Manifest fields: subject_id, deletion_ops:[], timestamp(ISO8601), nonce, manifest_hash(SHA256). I'll sign and upload to secure-bucket/privacy/9988/signed-manifest.json.sig and also include signature metadata.

noah: When uploading, include signature verification instructions so legal can confirm without key access: public key fingerprint, hash algorithm, and verification command.

ops-bot: created serviceAccount privacy-verifier@infra (svc-priv-558), expires in 3600s. Ticket COM-1452 opened.

elen: Thanks. @priya post the manifest here once signed and I'll request legal sign-off. Keep artifacts minimal and redacted.

priya: Will post shortly.
